doc.title: Rebecca Kilgore interviewed by Monk Rowe, Chautauqua, New York, September 13, 1997

title: Earlier career as a Cobol programmer
summary: She used to be a business programmer and now enjoys computers as a user.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: You had an earlier job with computers to mention.

And I still love computers. I don’t program them anymore. I used to program them but I left those days behind, I just use them now. I was a business programmer in the Cobol language. I actually liked it a long time ago, but it’s more fun to just use my Macintosh and use E-mail and all those fun programs.
